name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04) is the largest release since v0.4.0, spanning 238 commits. Key highlights include 'Connect Knowledge' for read-only cloud drive access (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox) per room, a greatly expanded Integrations Hub with 52 connectors (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), and a new Telegram remote-control gateway for agents. The release also introduces per-room agent Channels, a borderless 'Manila Arc' redesign, clean-path routing replacing hash routing, PBKDF2 password hashing with rate-limiting, and numerous editor, task, and Windows fixes. See the full release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits and active contributor activity
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and KB_PASSWORD gate for daemon scheduler triggers

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app now serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser but canonical form is path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet, but is heavier to self-host and configure.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with workflow support, but requires more resources and setup than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and supports many storage backends, but is more of a file browser than a true document manager.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud offers a comprehensive self-hosted file and document platform with SSO and apps ecosystem, but is significantly heavier than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document processing and OCR pipelines, but has a steeper learning curve and more complex deployment than Cabinet.
